I finished round 512 with no STOP: B's documentation patch went in exactly as written, and every check A owns passed. No `app/` file changed; I didn't run the browser rows, which belong to C.

**What changed:** I applied `b-round-511/sketch-512-docs.patch.txt` with `git apply`, after confirming its sha256 matched. It updates four docs and nothing else:
- `docs/design/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md`
- `docs/design/components/button.md`
- `docs/technical/components/ui-components.md`
- doc 330 (its line 4 now reads `Completed (C round 512 PASS)`)

The working tree is the expected 8 paths (6 modified, 2 untracked), and the `app` diff is the same 3 files as round 511.

**Checks run (all saved under `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-512/`):**
- **Frozen checks:** 1–4 passed before applying, and 1, 2, 3 and 5 passed again after all the tools had run (`frozen-final.txt`). The protected files are unchanged.
- **Typecheck:** passed.
- **Lint:** passed, still 174 warnings.
- **Covering tests:** 7 files, 92 tests passed. The slowest test took 765 ms, under C7's 2,500 ms limit.
- **Old-wording scan** on the three Button docs: 0 / 0 / 0.
- **Doc 330:** all 7 required headings are present and in order, and it no longer mentions "pending" or "C round 511 PASS".
- **Doc ledger** (`doc-ledger.md`): maps each changed sentence to a file and line in the code or to a test that exists.
- **Biome:** it doesn't check these Markdown files at all ("No files were processed"), so it adds nothing beyond `npm run lint`.

**code-reviewer** (real run, report in `code-review.md`): 9/10, with no Critical, High or Medium findings. It confirmed every variant, size, minimum width, colour, focus rule and test ID in the new text against the code. It found three Low wording issues, all inside B's patch, so I left them unedited and passed them to B:
- **A-R512-REVIEW-DOC330-HEAD-WORDING:** doc 330 line 22 says the docs now match HEAD, but they describe the uncommitted N2 work. HEAD still has the hand-built Buy Now until the gate publishes.
- **A-R512-REVIEW-DOC330-BUTTONMD-CLAIM:** the same line says all three docs used to call Buy Now `primary`, but the old `button.md` never mentioned Buy Now.
- **A-R512-REVIEW-DECISION-TREE-UNLOCK:** in the DESIGN_SYSTEM decision tree, Unlock Premium is also a direct purchase but stays `primary`. The tree only gets this right because it lists it by name.

The reviewer had no architecture note. The only fix I made was one wrong line number in my own ledger, which lives in the loop folder.

**Still open:**
- C's browser rows C3–C6, C7 and C8 still need to run.
- The full suite, build, verify and e2e smoke are for the root gate; I didn't run them.
- The Low about the "Added" pulse ignoring reduced motion is still deferred and unchanged.

The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-512.md`, and it lists the exact checks for C.
